image_description: A close-up photograph of a small butterfly perched on green vegetation. The butterfly has wings held closed, displaying a pale creamy-white to light brown coloration with distinct orange patches and dark spots (ocelli). The body is fuzzy/hairy and greyish-brown. Antennae are visible and appear clubbed. The background consists of out-of-focus green leaves and stems.

expert_testimonies.reason: To definitively identify the species. The Router suspects this is NOT a Ringlet due to color mismatch. The classifier will confirm if it is a mislabeled Ringlet or a different species entirely (e.g., Coenonympha pamphilus).
To check for edge bleeding between the delicate wing edges and the background, and to verify the structural integrity of the legs which appeared merged in the Router's inspection.
To assess the overall realism of the lighting, depth of field, and texture consistency, specifically looking for subtle 'AI smoothness' in the fuzzy body textures.
